# Chart.js 4.5.1 (vendored)

`chart.umd.min.js`, its source map and `LICENSE.md` (MIT) are copied unchanged from the npm
package `chart.js@4.5.1` (`dist/chart.umd.min.js`). Vendored, not an npm
dependency, so the app does not fetch it and its bytes change only in a commit.

- sha256 `48444a82d4edcb5bec0f1965faacdde18d9c17db3063d042abada2f705c9f54a`
- To update: `npm pack chart.js@<version>`, copy the same two files, update the
  version and checksum here and in `index.ts`, and look at the HP chart.
